content: परिक्रमः .²1 Roaming about, moving about; द्रुतपदमभियातुमिच्छितानां गगनपरिक्रमलाघवेन तासाम् <ls>Ki. 10. 2</ls>. .²2 Roaming, walking or passing over. .²3 Circumambulating. .²4 Walking for pleasure. .²5 Series, order. .²6 Succession. .²7 Penetrating. .²8 Following the course of a river down from its source to its mouth and then on the other bank upto its source again; <ls>MW.</ls>
